_comment: Non-secret identifiers only. The development Supabase project ref is a public identifier (it appears in the project URL). Production's ref is intentionally not listed here: guards only need to recognize the DEV project. `features` gates native sign-in/push configuration per variant: production stays all-false until the owner enables it for a release (and fills in the production Google client IDs). Google OAuth client IDs are public identifiers, not secrets.
